plot: On Luna's last day Max races to wrap a goodbye gift before her mom comes at sunset, but Luna keeps running off and he thinks she doesn't want to play; his idea of giving Grandma's gold show cup fails, Bird helps him pick his favorite red ball instead, and when the car arrives Luna gives him the gold Best Big Cousin star she secretly made all day; as the car leaves Grandma sneezes in the cold wind.

beats.say: Help! The sticky tape is stuck on my paws! Both paws!
Rip! Stick! The gift box rolls away. Max rolls after it.
Luna goes home at sunset. What gift can I give her?
It's Luna's last day. The sun is already sinking over the garden.
Max! Here's your red ball back. I'm going home soon.
Wait, Luna! Do you want to play one last game with me?
Not now! I'm busy! Don't look, Max! Don't look!
Luna runs behind Grandma. Bird flies after her, giggling. Hee hee hee!
Busy? On her last day? She doesn't want to play with me.
Maybe a really big gift will make her want to play again.
Max looks around the garden. Then he sees something shiny.
The gold cup! The Best Bouquet cup! That's the shiniest thing ever!
Max puts the gold cup into the red box. Tape, tape, tape.
Tape on the box. Tape on his tail. Tape on his whiskers.
Max! Is that Grandma's gold cup in there? Her first prize ever?
Uh... maybe? It's the best thing I could find.
You can't give away Grandma's cup! It belongs to Grandma!
And look at Luna's tiny bag. A cup that big won't fit!
Max opens the box. The gold cup goes back to its place.
The sun is going down. And I have nothing for Luna.
And she doesn't even want to play with me anymore.
Max. Think about it. What did Luna love most this week?
My sunset spot? My ball? Grandma's cookies? Everything I have!
No, silly. She loved holding your tail. Being with you!
Being with me? That's not a gift. You can't wrap that.
Then give her something that feels like you. Something with a story.
Max looks at the red ball. The ball that smells like Max.
The brave cat ball. She took it on her very first day.
It's my favorite ball in the whole world. My best ball.
That's why it's the perfect gift. Giving is hard when it matters.
Max puts the red ball in the box. Gently. Carefully.
And this time, he uses just one little piece of tape.
Done! And only one whisker is stuck. That's a new record!
Honk, honk! A little car stops at the garden gate.
Luna, sweetie! Your mom is here! Time to go home!
Hurry, Bird! Before the car leaves! Where is Luna?
Luna runs out from behind Grandma. Her paws are behind her back.
Max! Close your eyes! And hold out your paw! Now!
Max closes his eyes. Something small and light lands in his paw.
A gold star! I made it all day, with Bird and Grandma!
You were busy all day... making a gift for me?
It says Best Big Cousin. Grandma helped with the big words.
That's why she couldn't play! Secret mission! Tweet tweet!
And I thought you didn't want to play with me.
Silly Max. Secrets take a lot of work, you know!
I always want to play with you. You're THE Max!
Then this is for you. Open it. Only one piece of tape.
Luna pulls the tape. Rip! Inside is the red ball.
The brave cat ball? But it's your favorite one!
That's why. Now when it's dark, you'll still have a brave cat.
Luna hugs the ball. Then she hugs Max. A big, tiny hug.
Look at you two. The best gifts are made with love.
A gift doesn't have to be shiny or big.
It just has to come from your heart. Like this star.
Luna gets into the car with the red ball. Wave, wave, wave!
Bye, Max! Bye, Bird! Bye, Grandma! See you soon!
The car drives away into the orange sunset. The garden feels quiet.
I miss her already. But I have a gold star.
And she has your brave ball. You're both lucky cats.
A cold wind blows. Grandma waves one last time.
Ah... ah... ah... ACHOO!
Grandma? That was a big sneeze. Are you okay?
